description: Overzichtskaart afvalwaterketen, Waterbeheerplan is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maps.aaenmaas.nl. In the field of wastewater transport and wastewater treatment, the Water Board fully implements the 2011 Water Administrative Agreement. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Wastewater Chain Map, Water Management Plan" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Afvalwaterketen, Waterbeheerplan. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
